name: MonarchAiArtifactVersions
title: AiArtifactVersions
wrapsNative: MonarchAiMessageBranch (Material 3 IconButton) for previous and next, androidx.compose.material3.DropdownMenu with DropdownMenuItem behind a MonarchButton for the version menu, androidx.compose.material3.FilterChip for Compare, and MonarchDiffViewer for the changes; android.icu.text.DateFormat for the dates
summary: Steps through the versions of an AI artifact with previous and next buttons, the position, a menu to jump to any version and Compare with previous, which shows a diff of what changed.
whenToUse: Above a document, a reply or a piece of code that an AI model has rewritten several times, so people can go back to an earlier version and see what each rewrite changed.
whenNotToUse: For the regenerated versions of a chat reply, use MonarchAiMessageBranch alone. For the saved history of a document people edit, use MonarchVersionHistoryPanel.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchAiArtifactVersions(selection: Int, versions: List<MonarchAiArtifactVersion>, onSelectionChange: (Int) -> Unit, previousIcon: @Composable () -> Unit, nextIcon: @Composable () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, comparing: Boolean? = null, onComparingChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, granularity: MonarchDiffViewerGranularity = MonarchDiffViewerGranularity.Word, showCompare: Boolean = true, enabled: Boolean = true, locale: Locale? = null, timeZone: String? = null, menuIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiArtifactVersionsLabels = MonarchAiArtifactVersionsLabels())
data class MonarchAiArtifactVersion(version: Int, createdAt: Long, label: String? = null, content: String? = null)

class MonarchAiArtifactVersionsLabels(label: String? = null, position: ((version: Int, total: Int) -> String)? = null, previous: String? = null, next: String? = null, select: String? = null, versionTag: ((version: Int) -> String)? = null, versionName: ((version: Int) -> String)? = null, compare: String? = null, announce: ((version: Int, total: Int) -> String)? = null)

options.name: selection
options.description: The version number shown. A number not in versions shows the newest.

options.name: versions
options.description: Every version, in any order; shown oldest to newest, one per number (the last given wins). Each carries its date in epoch milliseconds and its content for the diff.

options.name: onSelectionChange
options.description: Called with the chosen version number, from the buttons or the menu.

options.name: previousIcon
options.description: The previous button's icon, such as a chevron to the start with mirrorInRtl = true. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: nextIcon
options.description: The next button's icon, mirrored in the same way.

options.name: comparing
options.description: Whether the diff with the previous version shows, when the app owns it with onComparingChange. null keeps the state in the stepper.

options.name: granularity
options.description: Whether the diff marks changed words (prose) or whole lines (code).

options.name: showCompare
options.description: Whether Compare with previous is offered.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the controls can be used, for example false while a new version streams.

options.name: locale
options.description: The locale of the dates in the menu. null uses the first locale of the configuration.

options.name: timeZone
options.description: The zone of the dates in the menu. An IANA id such as Europe/Berlin; null, or an id the device does not know, is the device's zone.

options.name: menuIcon
options.description: An icon after "Choose a version", such as a drop-down arrow. Decorative.

states.name: middle version
states.description: Previous and next are enabled; the position reads "Version 2 of 4".

states.name: single version
states.description: Both buttons are disabled; the position reads "Version 1 of 1"; there is no Compare.

states.name: menu open
states.description: A Material 3 drop-down menu lists every version as "v3 · Shorter intro · Nov 3, 2026, 2:05 PM"; the shown one is bold and selected.

states.name: comparing
states.description: Compare is selected (filled) and a MonarchDiffViewer from the previous version to this one shows under the controls, at most 384dp tall.

states.name: compare unavailable
states.description: No Compare when there is no previous version or either version has no content.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Every control is disabled and the position uses the disabled text color.

appearance: Two icon buttons around the position in caption text, a ghost "Choose a version" button and a Material 3 filter chip in the colors MonarchTheme gives Material 3 (filled when selected), then the diff viewer on its own surface with added and removed lines in their success and danger colors and signs. The same roles in dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Names follow iOS; Binding<Int> and Binding<Bool>? become selection with onSelectionChange and comparing with onComparingChange, and showsCompare is showCompare. The stepper reuses MonarchAiMessageBranch for previous and next, so its icons are required slots (Monarch bundles no icons). The web's native select and the iOS Menu with an inline Picker are a Material 3 DropdownMenu, the platform's menu, behind a ghost button. The web's aria-pressed compare button and the iOS button-style Toggle are a Material 3 FilterChip, read as selected or not. As on iOS, the diff is MonarchDiffViewer shown by the component when Compare is on, where the web calls onCompare for the app to render an AiArtifactDiff, so each version carries its content; on Android the diff is a lazy list, so it is held to 384dp and the stepper can sit in a screen that scrolls. A change from the buttons is announced by the branch as "Version 3 of 5"; a change from the menu is announced as "Showing version 3 of 5". Dates use android.icu.text.DateFormat in the given locale and time zone (the configuration's locale and the device's zone by default).
accessibility: The controls are a traversal group; previous, the position and next are a group named "Versions" (MonarchAiMessageBranch).
Previous and next are named "Previous version" and "Next version", keep 48dp touch targets, and are disabled at the ends.
The position is visible text, "Version 3 of 5", from the labels or the built-in string.
The menu button is named "Choose a version"; in the menu the shown version is selected and bold, so it never depends on color.
Compare is a filter chip read with its selected state.

A change of version from the buttons is announced by MonarchAiMessageBranch; a change from the menu is announced politely as "Showing version 3 of 5" from a live region that is always present, so nothing is announced at first.
The diff is MonarchDiffViewer with "Version 2" and "Version 3" as the names of its sides; changes are marked with signs as well as color.
edgeCases: Versions can arrive in any order; two entries with the same number keep the last.
A selection that is not a version number shows the newest, and onSelectionChange is not called for it.
Choosing the version already shown in the menu does nothing.
An empty content is compared as an empty text; a null content hides Compare.
Without onComparingChange and comparing the compare state survives configuration changes (rememberSaveable).

examples.title: Versions with compare
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space3)) {
    @OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
    MonarchAiArtifactVersions(
        selection = version,
        versions = versions,
        onSelectionChange = { version = it },
        previousIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ChevronLeft, contentDescription = null) },
        nextIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ChevronRight, contentDescription = null) },
        menuIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.ChevronDown, contentDescription = null) },
        locale = Locale.forLanguageTag("en-GB"),
        timeZone = "Europe/London",
    )
    Text(versions.first { it.version == version }.content.orEmpty())
}
